name: Iljuil Dwie Toesahamnida : Last Days at the Office
original_name: 일주일 뒤에 퇴사합니다 : Last Days at the Office
source:
A hyper-realistic K-office drama.

This is a story about quitting, and a record of your final attitude on the job.

In your last week, will you leave behind "work" or "people"?

Will you fill out every handoff document to be remembered as a flawless senior? Or will you throw all your tasks out the window, hoard office snacks, and completely lose it?

The game doesn't judge your morality. It simply shows you the unvarnished consequences of the attitude you chose.

It's okay to mess up. After all... you're leaving this company anyway.

Experience a final 5 days where alienation and absolute freedom coexist.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/5024830/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
一部超写实的韩式职场剧。

这是一个关于辞职的故事，也是一份记录你离职前最后职场态度的档案。

在上班的最后一周里，你选择留下的会是“工作成果”，还是“人情羁绊”？

你究竟会一丝不苟地填好每一份交接文档，作为无可挑剔的模范前辈被大家铭记？还是会把所有工作统统抛到九霄云外，疯狂搜刮茶水间零食，彻底放飞发疯？

游戏不会对你的道德水准指手画脚，只会如实为你展现你所选态度带来的真实后果。

搞砸了也没关系。毕竟……反正你马上就要离开这家公司了。

亲身体验疏离感与绝对自由并存的最后5天职场时光吧。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/5024830/]Steam[/url]]
